title: "Paper notes"
---

## Page header

Top line of every sheet:

```
2026-10-08 · diagnostic-01 · p1/3
2026-10-12 · Lang 1.3 · p1/2
```

## Problems

- Number in the left margin, circled: `(7)`. Book exercise: `Ex 1.3.5`.
- Box the final answer.
- Wrong path: one strike-through line. Do not erase.
- New attempt: `Att 2`.
- `?` in the margin: unsure about this step. Ask at supervision.
- Skipped: `S`.

## Proofs

```
Given: ...
Show:  ...
Proof: ...
                    ∎
```

## After the timer

Mark in a second colour: ✓ / ✗ / S. Write nothing else until supervision.

## Storage

Loose A4 sheets, one side only, in a binder by date.
